.claude/docs/workflow.md: This project uses a **reference-based** CLAUDE.md architecture — a thin CLAUDE.md index with deeper content in `.claude/docs/` (on-demand) and `.claude/rules/` (path-scoped). See `section-markers.md` in the Andromeda skills for the ownership convention between generated and user-curated sections.

.claude/rules/events.md: - 2026-10-16: A snapshot field that a reader expects once an event line is visible is written before that line is appended, never after: a reader that waits on the line and then reads the snapshot races a write made after it (the snapshot's `agent_session_id` and the `session-start` line).

.claude/rules/api.md: - 2026-11-24: A verb that opens its log on a home it resolved before that home existed holds the pre-creation spelling (through a link such as `target/e2e-home`): re-canonicalise the home after the log creates it, as `run` and `open` do, before any path from it reaches a child's argv or a record.

.claude/docs/gotchas.md: - For architectural decisions and their rationale, see `doc:architecture` Established Decisions section

.claude/rules/frontend.md: _This section is owned by `/wrap-session`. setup-project preserves content added here on re-run._

.claude/docs/commands.md: - `scripts/agent-run.sh logs --instance <name> | jq -c 'select(.record.level=="ERROR")'` — errors for one instance

.claude/rules/security.md: - 2026-11-24: A new verb that starts through `run::start` inherits every effect of that start, its trust step (the Claude trust-flag write and the kept `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` read) included: before naming the verb's surface or the masters' lists of starts, read the shared start's code for its writes and reads, not only the verb's own file.

.claude/rules/ci.md: - 2026-11-20: A WATCH's green run read from CI counts only on the watched test's own PASS line in that job's log (`gh run view <run> --log`), never on the job's success alone: a job can pass a run that never selected the test.

.claude/rules/testing.md: - 2026-11-25: A case whose start must end before its session starts (a not-resumed or otherwise sessionless child) cannot go through `Wrapper::adopt` or any readiness-waiting test wrapper, which waits for a readiness that start never reaches: run the verb piped outside a terminal, as `tests/cli_up.rs`'s sessionless start does, and read stdout and stderr apart.

.claude/rules/verification-harness.md: - 2026-11-24: A live-reading script prints verdict words from its plan's closed set alone: a state the set names no word for takes the set's nearest word (a hand wrapper never live reads `unread`), never a new word, and its rehearsal is fired again after the change.

.claude/rules/observability.md: - 2026-11-28: A new `ObsEvent` moves three lists, not two: both schemas' event enums AND the pinned `LOG_FORMAT_EVENTS` array in `tests/contract_diag_schema.rs`, which binds diag-line's and diag-detail's event enums to one list — a sweep of the role or event lists by their words misses it, and only `run --e2e` reads it red.
